issues.on_page: Capital outlay 3,331,241 (General 282,498, Road 56,120, Capital Projects 2,228,641, Non-Major 763,982); no function printed

The same printed Public works money is streets/highways in disbursements[2] but utilities here. Landfill as utilities is defensible, but the report is inconsistent with itself.
